connector.name: MCP Gera Clone
connector.registryDescription: GeraClone MCP - discover expert clones, check operator's clone status, start expert chats (consent).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-gera-clone. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the geraservicesuk account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GERACLONE_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of the GeraClone backend. Defaults to https://clone.gera.services/backend.

env.name: GERA_USER_TOKEN
env.description: JWT for the operator on whose behalf the agent acts. Required for start_chat_with_expert, my_clone_status, and my_corpus_summary.
